title: Skill: when an epic's done is a RUN, the epic contains the run
description:
Three ticfac epics closed without the run their acceptance named: every tick green against fakes, the production entry point never wired (an executor never registered; a Workflow no route created), the live run deferred elsewhere. The one gap only a live run shows surfaced after close.

Change: add to SKILL.md planning guidance / tick-patterns.md: when an epic's done is a run, (1) the FIRST tick wires the thinnest end-to-end path through the PRODUCTION entry point, tested through that entry point, and (2) a named tick INSIDE the epic performs the run before the final review. If the run genuinely lives in another epic, the acceptance says so in words. 'A seam nothing constructs is not delivery.'
acceptance_criteria: The planning guidance states both rules with an example epic layout (wire-first tick, run tick before final review); the pre-run review checklist asks 'if the done is a run, which tick performs it?'
